annotations.title: Order link (WhatsApp) for a product or VIP number

description: Builds a WhatsApp link with a ready order message to Baqer Store's sales team, for a product (URL or slug) or a VIP number (11 digits, e.g. 07855557555), plus the page URL where the customer can also order on the website. No order is created: the customer opens the link and sends the message. Give the link to the customer.
name: order_link
title: Order link (WhatsApp) for a product or VIP number
